teaser: The smell of sawdust and cold coffee sits in a trailhead parking lot before sunrise, gear half-sorted in the trunk. You are a 4, and a 4 wants the plan set the night before. You are an ENTP, and an ENTP wants to see if a better route exists five minutes after the plan is set. This crossing is a builder who keeps redesigning the foundation mid-pour. The 4 lays the first board down true. The ENTP wonders aloud whether the board should be a different shape entirely, and sometimes it should.
